Remember me in dua. Question: Assalmualaikum, I want the meaning of the names: (1) Basheer ahmad, a boy name & (2) Nida ,a girl name. Remember me in dua. Answer ID: 11863 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 538/538=M/1430) ?Basheer? means: one who gives glad tiding. ?Ahmad? means: admirable, one who is admired. "Nida" means: voice, proclamation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
